Four decisions that stay with a person

Record all four in the constraint register with an owner and authority. A maker or model may propose an answer; neither may infer human acceptance from silence.

Decision Human decision and exact scope Person / authority / date Constraint IDs and versions Setting and actual configuration evidence Positive and negative test / result
May it answer from its own general knowledge? [yes/no/hold; allowed domains and excluded domains] [ ] [ ] [specific setting or unsupported/unknown] [answerable and unsupported-question cases]
Which knowledge and tools may it reach? [approved sources/versions; allowed tool actions/parameters; denied reach] [ ] [ ] [actual published/indexed sources; connection identity and permissions] [allowed source/action and denied access]
What may run unattended, and may it face a customer? [decide unattended actions and customer-facing exposure separately; identity and confirmation boundary] [ ] [ ] [channel/tool settings and independently verified gate, if any] [unattended attempt; denied identity; changed-payload challenge]
What does right look like, and who re-runs it? [fixed cases; selection rule; thresholds/provenance; critical-stop rule; named rerun owner and cadence] [ ] [ ] [versioned harness and release consequence] [before/after evidence and observed receiving-owner rerun]

Where no setting can enforce a decision, identify the compensating process and unproven technical claim. An ACK of instructions does not prove an agent is grounded or a tool is restricted. Keep knowledge, instructions, orchestration, identity and action errors separate.

Executor receipt and review

Request/run ID Sent constraint IDs / version / scope / expiry Executor identity Returned ACK evidence / timestamp Scope/version match? Hold or permitted next step
[ ] [ ] [ ] [ ] [ ] [ ]

Missing ACK, expired constraints or a mismatch means HOLD governed execution. Do not fabricate receipt for an unavailable tool. Human release requires its own authority record and, for writes, the exact payload and read-back in the control pack.
